fact: A ministerial arrete of 27 August 2025 requires Starlink to keep user logs, IP addresses and traffic data for at least 24 months, hosted locally and accessible to national authorities, on pain of suspension or withdrawal of authorisation, with ARCEP the supervising regulator.
title: Télécoms : N’Djamena accentue la pression sur Airtel, Moov et Starlink
